notes.title: NEW UPDATE! - changelog #11
notes.content:
WHAT'S NEW
- New Juicer UI!
- Final English, French, Italian, German and Spanish localisations implemented!
- Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese and Russian localisations has been added!
- "Basics" Tutorial has been added!
- Tutorial sections are now more linear (players no longer need to press the Confirm button each time a sub-section is completed)!
- Online disconnection/error messages have been added!
- Time Attack medals earned are now shown in the tracks selection page (thanks to Erdbeermilch)!
- "Autorespawn" feature added (if you get stuck the kart will respawn automatically after a few seconds)!
- Some additional animations for female characters have been added!
- Brand new store icons and text!

FIXES
- FPS improvements on all tracks, expecially in Split Screen and Online
- 1st person camera now works as intended
- LOD switch issues no longer occur
- Fixed several online stability issues
- Fixed issues with online game invites, online chat and online game flow
- Some Time Attack times have been nerfed
- A number of achievements now unlock properly upon meeting the set criteria
- Fixed a game issue occuring when running Steam in offline mode (thanks to [ANH] TornaderX)
- Several minor fixes

KNOWN ISSUES
 - A couple of font issues displayed in asian languages
 - In Elimination mode "Change Camera" button displayed when you are eliminated doesn't work

STAY FRUIT! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: DEVBLOG #8 - FOLLOW THE FRUITS
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/2d6e691d55487287cd788c9398e81f6b087dc086.png[/img]

First of all sorry for the lack of updates during the last couple of weeks – everything has been ready but some operational gremlins have prevented us from posting them. 

We have so many things to set up right! From now on there will be more more frequent updates! 


[h1]ALL-STAR FRUIT RACING - YOGSCAST DLC[/h1]

We have some wonderful news to celebrate Christmas! The 3DClouds' team has provided an Exclusive DLC for super special Humble Bundle "Yogscast Jingle Game 2017". 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/e0410a426b92907139b4a65aab28a63a5e5cbdcb.png[/img]

The Yogscast Jingle Jam is back, and as always, 100% of the proceeds go to charity. You can find more information about that: https://www.humblebundle.com/yogscast-jingle-jam-2017

For those of you who celebrate Christmas have a great time.

You can buy it from here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/752540/AllStar_Fruit_Racing__Yogscast_Exclusive_DLC/

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/6051fe61bc890a4942e79b70c87c8bd6b0fb0459.jpg[/img]


[h1]WHAT'S NEW[/h1]

° [b]Second Online implementation[/b]: Championship, Lobby Edit, all Race Modes and Invitations are now all accessible and playable also online!

More power to the host! After the lobby has been created the host will be able to customize the AI difficulty and the total number of tracks (from 1 to 6). The host will be able to pick tracks among all the 21 available in the game (provided that he has unlocked each and every one of them :). 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/071555ae6f64e505f597ca9ab041a6ac56d7fd29.gif[/img]

The host will be also able to choose for each track the number of laps (from 1 to 5) and the race mode among all the 5 available ([b]Random Juicer, Juicer, Dragster, Elimination and Elimination Mix[/b]) . A "Random" button is available in order to let the game customize the lobby at the host place! Client will be able to join meanwhile the host is preparing the lobby. Clients will be able to race on tracks they haven't already unlocked offline in online mode exclusively (provided the host did it). "Invite Friend" button will open a Steam overlay letting you choose which friend to invite!

° Please refer to the [b]"Online Known Issues"[/b] below in order to understand what is not working at the moment and please share your feedback, bugs, and comments on "Online - Second Implementation" discussion.
- New characters unlocked: Kiwi, Raspberry and Clementine!
- Apple Pikes and Poseimon tracks have been updated and transformed from point to point tracks into full circuits! Apple Pikes now is the longest track of the game :)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HiJwNpR.gif[/img]

[h1]FIXES[/h1]
- FPS improved on Split Screen and menus
- Slightly improved online stability
- Several achievements and unlockables have been fixed
- AI behaviour on-track improved – its now less random and more realistic
- Some localization fixes
- Several minor fixes

[img]https://i.imgur.com/jpGCIws.gif[/img]

[h1]KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]
- Bonnet camera needs several optimizations
- Pad disconnection during race still needs to be managed accordingly
- A few issues in Elimination mode
- French, German and Spanish localisations not available on the new features (we are working on the translation but they are only in English for now)
- Rare freeze on loading screens (if you find a consistent repro steps please let us know! :) )
- Some LOD issues

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8QDh1Fr.gif[/img]

[h1]ONLINE KNOWN ISSUES[/h1]
- In order to put the focus on a specific lobby to join on the lobby list the only way to do it is to press TAB button until the focus is over the desired lobby
- Sometimes podium is not displayed 
- Sometimes the track overprint shown at the beginning of the race is incorrect
- Pausing the race before ending it will cause instability issues for all players in the same lobby
- Accepting invites in peculiar situations (into other modes, into another lobby, etc..) could cause instability issues for all players in the same lobby
- Disconnection error messages have been improved but are still WIP
- On some tracks the animations are not working properly when playing online, for example the dinosaur “Pear-Ex” in the Dino Juice track ......is Pear-Ex ok for you?:)

Fresh news! We are working on a new fantastic island! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/oY6Tor5.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/KBJa1FL.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/0jRMbtG.gif[/img]


[b]Wishing you and your family a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/fd9b5dab171eaf21953930b28642401186e5f17a.jpg[/img]

notes.title: NEW UPDATE! - changelog #8
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/16b3678085914b39a7fdead4c8d0f0680e97f450.gif[/img]

ːsteamhappyː *What's New* ːsteamhappyː
- The very first........ O N L I N E implementation!  
The player now is able to create lobbies and join browsing them (remember to update the lobby list using "Refresh" button). 
The Host is able to select a track, track length, race mode and difficulty. Host and Client can both change the character and the kart preset while waiting for the race to start.
At the moment only two race modes are available (Juicer and Random Juicer) and the only way to change the track selected is to quit the lobby and create another one.
When the Host selects "Ready" a 30 seconds countdown starts and when it finishes the race starts. Clients are able to shorten the countdown to 10 seconds only if every one of them have pressed the "Ready" button.
If a Client disconnects during the race an AI will take control of the kart.
After the race has finished, clients will need to wait on the recap page in order to race again (waiting for the host to return to the lobby). 
Please refer to the "Online Known Issues" below in order to understand what is not working at the moment and please share your feedback, bugs, and comments on "Online - First Implementation" discussion
- MilkLake track has been transformed into a circuit!
- "Unlockables" table available! (you'll find it in "Extra" section)
- "Special Moves Combinations" table added (you'll find it into race pause and Training section)

ːsteammockingː *Fixes* ːsteammockingː
- Pomegranate Mega-Juice move now works as intended
- AI behavior on-track improved
- Fixed Maracuja Bay and Dino Juice intro cinematics
- Several fixes on Time Attack times to beat
- Random freezes staying idle have been fixed
- Some localization fixes
- Several minor fixes

 ːsteamsadː *Known Issues* ːsteamsadː
- Bonnet camera needs several optimizations
- Pad disconnection during race still needs to be managed accordingly
- A few issues in Elimination mode
- French, German and Spanish localisations not available on the new features (English is returned)

ːsteamsadː *Online Known Issues* ːsteamsadː
- Sometimes if a player has been shot by an opponent his kart will lose speed continuously and will be unable to regain it.
- Sometimes clients could start the race with the camera placed under the kart: if that occurs the camera will return to the correct position soon after passing the starting line.
- All disconnection error messages still need to be managed accordingly ("Network Error" text displayed)
- If Host pauses the race also the clients are paused
- Several tracks "easter eggs" are not working online (i.e. Pear-Ex in Dino Juice......is Pear-Ex ok for you?   )
- Some online achievements are not working (the ones affecting all modes work on all modes except online).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/16b3678085914b39a7fdead4c8d0f0680e97f450.gif[/img]

ːsteamhappyː *What's New* ːsteamhappyː
- The very first........ O N L I N E implementation!  
The player now is able to create lobbies and join browsing them (remember to update the lobby list using "Refresh" button). 
The Host is able to select a track, track length, race mode and difficulty. Host and Client can both change the character and the kart preset while waiting for the race to start.
At the moment only two race modes are available (Juicer and Random Juicer) and the only way to change the track selected is to quit the lobby and create another one.
When the Host selects "Ready" a 30 seconds countdown starts and when it finishes the race starts. Clients are able to shorten the countdown to 10 seconds only if every one of them have pressed the "Ready" button.
If a Client disconnects during the race an AI will take control of the kart.
After the race has finished, clients will need to wait on the recap page in order to race again (waiting for the host to return to the lobby). 
Please refer to the "Online Known Issues" below in order to understand what is not working at the moment and please share your feedback, bugs, and comments on "Online - First Implementation" discussion
- MilkLake track has been transformed into a circuit!
- "Unlockables" table available! (you'll find it in "Extra" section)
- "Special Moves Combinations" table added (you'll find it into race pause and Training section)

ːsteammockingː *Fixes* ːsteammockingː
- Pomegranate Mega-Juice move now works as intended
- AI behavior on-track improved
- Fixed Maracuja Bay and Dino Juice intro cinematics
- Several fixes on Time Attack times to beat
- Random freezes staying idle have been fixed
- Some localization fixes
- Several minor fixes

 ːsteamsadː *Known Issues* ːsteamsadː
- Bonnet camera needs several optimizations
- Pad disconnection during race still needs to be managed accordingly
- A few issues in Elimination mode
- French, German and Spanish localisations not available on the new features (English is returned)

ːsteamsadː *Online Known Issues* ːsteamsadː
- Sometimes if a player has been shot by an opponent his kart will lose speed continuously and will be unable to regain it.
- Sometimes clients could start the race with the camera placed under the kart: if that occurs the camera will return to the correct position soon after passing the starting line.
- All disconnection error messages still need to be managed accordingly ("Network Error" text displayed)
- If Host pauses the race also the clients are paused
- Several tracks "easter eggs" are not working online (i.e. Pear-Ex in Dino Juice......is Pear-Ex ok for you?   )
- Some online achievements are not working (the ones affecting all modes work on all modes except online).

notes.title: DEVBLOG #7 - PLAY TOGETHER!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/ca9799106938b1c5cae527e1899821b8896c3b2f.png[/img]

Hi, there! 3DClouds here! As many of you already know we are working hard in order to complete the [b]Online Mode[/b]. We are also working on all the community advice and feedback so you can have what you've asked in terms of implementations and new contents :)

We're late but.. Happy Halloween :) So, would you like to play on a track inspired by Halloween? Trick or treat?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/pLEQZiG.gif[/img]
 
We are fully aware that the things to improve are many and of a wide variety... For this reason, we are taking the right time to complete these tasks. Thank you for all the support and discussions opened on our socials and [b]Discord channel[/b] to assist us to improve the game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cUIg7ke.gif[/img]
 
[h1]Kart poll[/h1]
In the past days, we have asked you which kart you prefer the most from a selection given. Well, the winner is the kart number 6! Honestly, we didn't expect this result 'cause the number 6 is the most similar to the real ones. We thought you'd like a very different shape, but "the player is always right" so we will add it in the game as promised :D

New polls and contests are waiting for you, stay tuned!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/dae6c15f30a81d91a790a39961967038b8db937a.jpg[/img]


[h1]Unlockables System[/h1]
In the next update (available within a few days) we are going to implement a brand new page that will help you unlock....everything! Throughout this page, you'll find all the unlockables items in the game in order to obtain them all!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/nuLQZAk.gif[/img]

 
[h1]Online Mode[/h1]
There we are, straight to the point! We nearly got the job done. A first release of the [b] Online Mode [/b] will be available in the upcoming update together with everything we listed so far.

At the very beginning, everyone will be able to create a lobby and join them.
We decided to implement only the basic flow (for the moment) in order to get as much feedback as possible from you and test the servers' efficiency. 

Subsequently, we will implement the [b]rank system, Championship mode, and other game modes.[/b] You'll have all the tracks in the game and you can join up to [b]8 players[/b]. The first mode we'll implement will be [b]Random Juicer race[/b].
 
Going into Online mode the game will load the last custom kart saved and the last character selected, then you will be able to choose another character and/or customize your kart. All unlockables available in this mode will be the ones you have already unlocked playing the game so far.
 
After this update, we will continue working on the other features.
For example, on the right side of the page, you'll have all the lobbies listed by ranking and number of players (rankings will be available shortly).
 
These will be the options that will be able to perform the user once the implementation in-game will be complete:
[b]- Search for custom Races
- Search for custom Championships
- Host a custom race or a custom Championship[/b]
 
Upon joining [b]Custom Race and Custom Championship[/b] lobbies the player will be put into the most populated lobby with a similar ranking. The host will be able to start a race only if at least a single has joined the lobby. When the Host pushes the "Start" button a 30 seconds countdown is played before the race starts. The countdown is reduced to 10 seconds if all clients available press the "Ready" button.

 
We're so excited to this update and we can't wait to look for your feedback. 
Other features will be added soon! Stay Tuned and play together! 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iM4wFoy.gif[/img]

notes.content:
New, features and fixes available!

** What's New **
- Unlockable Characters: Blackberry
- New Difficulty Level: 3 Pistons (unlocked if you achieve at least the 3rd place in Fruits Star cup)

- Bonnet camera added! (pressing "V" or "D-PAD Up" button)
- 2-wheels drifting kart animation added!

- Several localization fixes
- AIs more balanced
- Drift mechanics improved
- Several skills effects have been slightly changed
- AI times on race results page fixed

- All boosts are now cumulative (previously only the best one affected the player's speed)
- Fixed a bug on Random Juicer mode that affected several PC configurations causing inability to launch special moves
- More realistic kart weight
- Collisions among vehicles tweaked
- Motion blur option added on settings page
- Back, left and right camera view now is immediately set in the correct position pressing the proper button
- Several particles optimizations
- Fixed AI respawn exiting from Icy Grapes tunnel
- Several improvements on Frozen Castle track
- Some minor fixes

** Known Issues **
- AIs don't use special moves in Random Juicer mode
- Bonnet camera needs several optimizations
- Pad disconnection during race still needs to be managed accordingly
- Some issues on Elimination mode
- Several issues on Time Attack UI

notes.title: DEV BLOG #5 - WEEKLY UPDATES
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/9a688499b1f320ad70d503373be2711cb8b1fe01.png[/img]

Hey, folks!
Here we are with fruity and cool updates you cannot miss!

We would love to thank you for the feedbacks received. It's very important to us in order to improve the quality of [b]All-Star Fruit Racing[/b]. There are a few things that we would be able to fix in a short time and others which will require more time and resources. We have spent hours and hours to listen, watching videos and reading your comments, your reviews etc... [b]Every information from you is very inspiring for us![/b]

[h1]MILAN GAMES WEEK 2017[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/8348051a11339a06bea13fe371d4785ccd41fe28.png[/img]

We'd like to remind you our participation at [b]Milan Games Week 2017[/b] – from [b]September 29th[/b] to [b]October 1st[/b]. The majority of 3DClouds team is formed by italians and [b]Milan Games Week[/b] event is the best video games exhibition in Italy so we are very proud of it. Our game has been admitted to be one of the 40 best indie games in Italy in 2017! Come by and say hi!

[h1]NEW UPDATES COMING[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/9ecdaed16707588c1c9b7c06fd80eebc0bc10099.png[/img]

The next update will be a lovely gift to all the players that decided to trust in 3DClouds buying All-Star Fruit Racing during Steam [b]Early Access[/b]! Up until now, you have been able to race at best on 2 Pistons difficulty... from now on you will be able to reach 3 Pistons difficulty which is the most challenging one in the game! Furthermore, 7 more cups have been added in Career mode... and a brand new island featuring 5 amazing tracks!

New characters and kart customizations will be available to unlock, check out the unlockables list to figure out how to unlock them!

[h1]FIFTH ISLAND[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/ce3def269bfcde62327381e52c9a755d9ff41eca.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/25cc808e5cdf99c9fe2a8e51b1213f4b84ede3db.png[/img]

Four seasons, for us, were not enough so we decided to create a new one assembling all the ideas we gathered throughout the production flow. We decided to share these contents with you, please let us know if you like them and share your opinions about new potential tracks based on locations we didn't have considered so far! Maybe in the future, who knows :P 

[b]Some clues about the tracks[/b]
- [b]Savana Core[/b]: located in Africa. This track is inspired to famous classic animated movies!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/234761a8081cfe2a38d3789b67debad2f17147a5.png[/img]
- [b]Seed Cloud[/b]: a race through the clouds, towards the Olympus of fruit!

notes.title: Gameplay Modes: Random Juicer & Juicer
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/39cb0ff7140965021c5b2b68c52bbcf78e7449dd.png[/img]

Hi guys,

we are really excited! [b]All-Star Fruit Racing[/b] will be released in [b]Early Access[/b] in a few hours! This project is very important for us and, we fervently hope that All-Star Fruit Racing will become one of your favorite games!

As announced before, we'll be working hard to [b]release a new update every week[/b]. Our goal is to release, as soon as possible, the online multiplayer. We are perfectioning some online details but, first of all, we prefer you training for the big online challenges.

We recommend to start immediately with [b]Career Mode[/b]: in this way, you can unlock new characters, new tracks and new difficulty levels, as soon as possible. So you'll begin to taste the game a little by little.

At [b]Day 1 of Early Access[/b], you can play [b]2 different Gameplay Modes[/b]: [b]RANDOM JUICER[/b] and [b]JUICER[/b]. Dragster, Elimination and Elimination Mix will be added during Early Access, as soon as they are ready.


In this DevBlog #3, we explain the first two Gameplay Modes.

 
[h1]RANDOM JUICER[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/a7887641f986979c28f376275812a4356084ce0b.gif[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/654fcdf602e271d99ff306a8a08a6fe1b3850d18.gif[/img]

It is the [b]less strategic mode[/b]: [b]Random Juicer[/b] is perfect for a new player because it gives the chance to learn and to become familiar with tracks, characters, racing formats and other essential features.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/FQx0Id0.gif[/img]

In the Random Juicer mode, players collect a “surprise” bubble which gives a random move, within all available! 


[h1]JUICER[/h1]

notes.title: DEVBLOG #02 - Early Access is coming!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/220bace9c3442cd2bbe178f7e2932dc3b70f4c90.png[/img]

[h1]All-Star Fruit Racing: Early Access countdown begins![/h1]
 Are you ready for [b]September 4th[/b]? 

[b]4 islands, 4 tracks each[/b], will be available at the very beginning of the Early Access version. The [b]first 2 islands[/b] will be immediately available and you'll unlock the other 2 through game progression. 

A [b]5th island (5 tracks included) will be released during EA.[/b] 
A total of 21 unique tracks! 😊


Below, you'll find the [b]Summer and Winter islands "Making of"[/b], from the sketches to the final design:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/35b1a5cdac249017610b10431816ba61245e4d2b.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/7ba46aadf12828892ff92c6b17d667ffa5abc04c.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/bcd3e9a76931bafee87f5564c50c0a9e13dd406e.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/9123f97926e387f7fab9a87d3df3b61f6a3db06f.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/60d259e8667d882c898192cff167ca1091adad9e.jpg[/img]

[b]Coco Sunshine[/b] island reveal (2D and 3D):

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/f1bb9e524ee0a3ae9a1a360cd048bc76bdeb592c.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/e6be0aa9dd867e946cd4c0c0bebb020fdffff8ed.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/406d4e0907d783225582ade58e51805fb622b600.jpg[/img]


3DClouds is a blended team that assembles both veterans and rookies... their combination has made this happen. Our "elite juvenile" has grown in a way that we are very proud of, both in qualities and skills. They have created the structure of the game and the veterans made it solid and valuable.

[b]Online Mode[/b] will not be available at the start of Early Access, we're working hard to make this feature fun and stable for a pleasing and entertaining user game experience! [b]We'll do our best to release Online Mode as soon as possible (released during Early Access).[/b]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/9d07f7044de7fe966621401999373de56b13d941.jpg[/img]
 
[h1]All-Star Fruit Racing attended to Gamescom 2017![/h1]
Anyone who has not lived or worked in Italy may not be aware that Italy almost closes down during [b]August[/b], the cities empty as everyone runs to the beach or the mountains to escape the heat but a part of our team took part at the [b]Gamescom[/b]. It was an amazing experience! 

We had a lot of fun and met so many people... It was a pleasure showing the hard work we did during the last year. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30068487/39e3e555a56ea70f0ba945b6d1c89d127547ac49.jpg[/img]

So all we have to do now is waiting for [b] September 4th[/b] and play the game with all of you guys and girls! [b]See you soon![/b]
